claim: Chaining LLM agents compounds per-step errors geometrically (R = p^n): at 95% per-step reliability, a 5-step agent pipeline drops to ~77% end-to-end success and ~60% by 10 steps, making multi-agent pipelines mathematically unreliable past ~10 steps.
source: MindStudio blog 'The compounding problem' (2026-05-17) + repeated verbatim by Zartis, cloudai.pt, Stackademic (2026-07-06) and other vendor blogs, always without measured data
intake_channel: community-folklore scout (5+ independent repetitions, quoted as measured fact)
